scope: development-only confirmed append-only credential installation and exact pending recovery
commands: Reuse the pinned delivery chunk and verify commands for the selected installation transfer.
confirmation: Workshop verifies a fresh signed review and device identity, saves the exact local intent, and asks separately before confirm. Device, boot, build, transfer, challenge, envelope, reviewed state and fault mode must match. Disconnect or expiry before worker claim cancels; a claimed write retains its buffers until completion or quarantine.
serialization: Retained staging excludes competing flash and crypto work. Recheck native journal safety and credential trust immediately before writing. A flash timeout quarantines all competing admissions until physical restart.
storage: Two matching authenticated copies; at most nine occupied positions including the first. No erase or reclamation. A full journal refuses a new write. Equivalent signed-content retry preserves existing copies without claiming new envelope bytes were written.
recovery: A committed pending intent admits only the exact envelope. Prior copies remain preserved but are not silently ready. Uncommitted or uncertain intents remain protected and may be unavailable.
fault: Mode 1 is an explicit development-only stop after a committed intent, before starting either copy; it is admitted only on an empty journal. It is not power-loss qualification. Mode 0 is ordinary installation or recovery.
signature: P-256 ECDSA SHA-256, raw r[32] || s[32]; ASCII fields each followed by LF
limits: No ownership or command authority is granted. Lost transport is uncertain until inspected. Physical installation, preservation, restart, power-loss, timing and endurance need separately recorded device evidence. Unknown-byte preparation uses a separate inspection-bound workflow.

preparation.scope: separate development maintenance; never invoked automatically by installation
preparation.review: Fresh verified identity and read-only full-region inspection. Confirm within 25 seconds, bound to device, boot, build and region SHA-256; save consent and intent before command.
preparation.admission: Only unknown bytes are eligible. Blank, recognizable, partial/interrupted, unavailable or changed bytes are refused. Reinspect under the serialized worker immediately before erase. Guard each page and verify blank readback.
preparation.uncertainty: Timeout quarantines the common flash owner. Lost transport is uncertain. Preserve every attempt; new inspection and confirmation are required before any retry.
preparation.response: Reuse the pinned credential-storage response. Require matching request and boot, no failure, blank classification and SHA-256 of exactly 8192 erased bytes.
